title: Indonesian Cosmetics Intelligence
description: Monitor BPOM cosmetics records for brands, registrants, products, registration numbers, or composition keywords and detect trustworthy new or changed products across runs.

brands.title: Brands to monitor
brands.description: Cosmetics brands to monitor in BPOM. Each brand is queried separately.

registrants.title: Registrants / companies
registrants.description: Optional BPOM registrant or company names to monitor.

registrationNumbers.title: Registration numbers (NIE)
registrationNumbers.description: Optional BPOM registration numbers to monitor.

compositions.title: Composition keywords
compositions.description: Optional composition or ingredient keywords supported by the BPOM filter.

maxItemsPerQuery.title: Maximum results per query
maxItemsPerQuery.description: 0 = no item limit. For production monitoring, keep this at 0 so the complete matching result set is checked.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Maximum pages per query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Safety cap for BPOM pagination. Increase this if a monitored brand has more results than the current cap can cover.

detailStrategy.title: Product detail strategy
detailStrategy.description: Controls when the Actor opens BPOM product detail. changesOnly is recommended for production monitoring.
enumTitles: Only for new or changed products

baselineWarmupRuns.title: Trusted baseline warm-up runs
baselineWarmupRuns.description: Number of successful full-coverage runs used to build a trusted union baseline before NEW alerts are enabled. Recommended: 3.

newProductWindowDays.title: New product issued-date window (days)
newProductWindowDays.description: After the trusted baseline is ready, a first-seen product is classified as NEW only when its BPOM issued date is within this many days. Older or unknown dates are classified as DISCOVERED.

detectChanges.title: Detect changes across runs
detectChanges.description: Compare current records with a persistent snapshot. When disabled, records are emitted as SNAPSHOT events.

emit.title: Records to output
emit.description: all = every record; changes = trusted NEW or CHANGED records only; new = trusted NEW only. BASELINE and DISCOVERED records are visible with all but do not trigger changes output.

stateStoreName.title: State store name
stateStoreName.description: Named Apify Key-Value Store used to persist monitoring snapshots.

stateKey.title: Watchlist state key
stateKey.description: Unique key for this watchlist. Keep the same key across scheduled runs. Use a new key when starting a new independent trusted baseline.

requestDelayMs.title: Delay between interactions (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Delay between BPOM interactions to reduce request pressure on the public source.

allowPartialSnapshotUpdate.title: Allow partial snapshot updates
allowPartialSnapshotUpdate.description: Advanced. If enabled, the Actor may update stored observations even when full result coverage was not achieved. Partial runs never advance trusted-baseline readiness. Keep disabled for production monitoring.
